overview: This is the standard glacier line up Little Tahoma, named for the two glaciers it crosses (Fryingpan and Whitman). It was first climbed August 29, 1894 by J.B. Flett and Henry H. Garrison.
beta: From a high camp near Summerland/Meany Crest, rope up and cross the Fryingpan Glacier southwest toward Whitman Crest, then drop onto the Whitman Glacier and climb steepening snow/ice (up to about 45 degrees) toward the east shoulder. The technical crux is really the combination of glacier travel and the final loose rock, not any single hard move; the last 400-800 ft is Class 2-3 (locally Class 4) scrambling on rotten andesite to the true summit.
